sloka: आगत्यापीह हरयो भविष्यन्ति निररथकाः ।न हि युद्धेन व लङ्का शक्या जेतुं सुरैरपि ॥५-२-२७॥
transliteration: āgatyāpīha harayo bhaviṣyanti nirarathakāḥ ।na hi yuddhena va laṅkā śakyā jetuṁ surairapi ॥5-2-27॥

translations.english: 'It is not possible for monkeys to come here and even if they do, it is no use. Lanka is invincible even to the gods in war.
